stem.text: The diagram shows an experiment to determine the force exerted on a ball by a horizontal air flow.

stem.alt: Ball hanging on a string that is deflected 30° from the vertical, with an arrow labelled air flow pointing left towards the ball.

stem.text: The ball is suspended by a light string and weighs $0.15\,\text{N}$.
The deflection of the string from vertical is $30^{\circ}$. The ball is in equilibrium.
What is the force on the ball from the air flow?
